Economy · India

Data Centres Gain Prominence as IT Services Companies Invest Heavily

The Indian IT services sector is increasingly focusing on data centres, driven by growing demand for cloud computing and artificial intelligence. This shift is expected to have a significant impact on the real estate sector, with data centres potentially becoming its next growth pillar. The investment in data centres is also expected to drive an exponential increase in server demand.
